# AniHubStream

> AniHubStream is a free anime streaming platform providing fast playback, weekly airing schedules, and complete episode guides.

## Sections
- [Anime Catalogue](https://anihubstream.com/anime): Complete list of available anime titles with genre, year, and rating filters.
- [Airing Schedule](https://anihubstream.com/schedule): Weekly airing schedule of currently broadcasting anime.
- [Genres](https://anihubstream.com/genres): Categorized anime by Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Romance, and Sci-Fi.
- [Discover](https://anihubstream.com/discover): Curated trending releases and community favorites.
- [About](https://anihubstream.com/about): Mission, catalog sources (Kitsu, AniList), and architecture.
- [DMCA Policy](https://anihubstream.com/dmca): Copyright policy and infringement notification details.
